clue.text: Depleted legislators, president having lost fifth in elections

indicators.note: the president's name loses a letter, so something is taken out of it

parts.note: Donald Trump was the US president when the puzzle appeared

indicators.note: the fifth letter of the word elections is the one picked out

explanation.walkthrough: The fifth letter of 'elections' is T; 'having lost' removes it from TRUMP.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rump Parliament was what remained of the English Long Parliament after it was purged, so the word names a depleted body of legislators.
